section.content: 本实用新型公开了种生物基因样本存取仓，属于生物样本冷冻存储设备技术领域，包括存取仓体、包覆在存取仓体周围的密封保温板和位于存取仓体顶部的摄像机，所述存取仓体的底面上设有存储盒，存储盒的上方设有用于夹取存储盒内基因样品试管的驱动机构；所述存取仓体的内部设有冷却风扇，冷却风扇的前方设有氮气管；所述存取仓体的底面上开设有取样孔，取样孔设有与其相匹配的密封盖，密封盖连接有启闭装置；所述取样孔与存储盒之间设有二维扫码器，解决现有的存取仓对基因样本的取放准确度和效率较低的问题。

The utility model discloses a biological gene sample access storehouse belongs to the freezing storage device technical field of biological sample, including the access storehouse body, cladding around the body of access storehouse sealed heated board and be located the camera that takes the photograph at access storehouse body top, be equipped with the storage box on the bottom surface of the access storehouse body, the top of saving the box is equipped with and is used for pressing from both sides the actuating mechanism who gets the interior gene sample test tube of storage box, the inside of the access storehouse body is equipped with cooling fan, and the place ahead of cooling fan is equipped with the nitrogen gas pipe, the power distribution box comprises a box body, be equipped with two -dimentional bar code collector between thief hole and the storage box, solve current access storehouse and put the degree of accuracy and the lower problem of efficiency to getting of gene sample.

A kind of biological gene sample accesses storehouseTechnical field

The utility model is related to biological gene sample access arrangement technical field, in particular to a kind of biological gene Sample accesses storehouse.

Background technology

Biological sample bank is primarily referred to as standardization and collects, processes, storing and using strong also known as biobank (Biobank) The large biological molecule of health and disease organism, cell, tissue and organ equal samples (including human organ tissue, whole blood, blood plasma, Serum, biological fluid through treated biological specimen (DNA, RNA, albumen etc.) and related to these biological specimens face The data such as bed, pathology, treatment, follow-up, informed consent and its quality control, information management and application system.

The inside of existing biological gene sample access arrangement can not quickly and accurately recognize cdna sample test tube, so that When being gripped to gene test tube, success rate is relatively low and the gripping degree of accuracy is relatively low, not enough reaches from cdna sample storehouse Cdna sample is quickly and accurately taken out or deposited, is unfavorable for the fast development of biological gene sample freezer storage industry.
